title: Olive Plants a Seed
note: b416 — Phase 4 complete (Learning) — new consonant clusters nd, nt, nk, ft, lt, lf.

pages.brief: Moss the hedgehog carefully pressing a small seed into a hole in the vegetable patch.
Moss the hedgehog digging a small hole and dropping the seed inside.
Olive the owl watching Moss, holding her own seed in one claw.
Olive the owl scratching a shallow hole in the soil.
Olive the owl dropping her seed into the shallow hole, the seed resting visibly on the surface.
Close view of Olive's seed sitting exposed on top of the soil.
Moss the hedgehog leaning over, showing Olive how deep to dig.
Olive the owl pressing the soil flat over her now properly buried seed.
Olive the owl and Moss the hedgehog looking pleased at two neat patches of soil.
